citations.quote: The reconciliation of net income (loss) attributable to Caesars to Adjusted EBITDA is attached at the end of this press release.

segment_disclosure.explanation: Segment net revenues are printed in the release and the management discussion, but this book carries no segment schedule

limitations: Per-share lines are U.S. dollars per share and share counts are millions of shares; the book unit MILLIONS applies to dollar amounts only.
Cells the statements print as an em dash are recorded as not applicable with a reason, not as zero.
No debt facility rows, add-backs, segment schedule or KPI schedule are submitted in this book; the debt note is read by later modules.
Statements are taken from the three filed documents only; nothing is restated or adjusted.
No metric definition is assessed: the book carries no Adjusted EBITDA and no covenant definition is in the pack.

findings.title: Interim and release figures are unaudited

evidence.text: carry unaudited statements, while the annual report

risk_mechanic.text: relies on unaudited interim amounts for the current period, so a later restatement or auditor adjustment would move them.

credit_implication.text: stay provisional until the next audited annual statements.

findings.title: The pending Merger is an unresolved event after the audited year

evidence.text: The pack records the Merger agreement of May 27, 2026 as an announced event
that follows the fiscal year in the annual report and that has not closed.

risk_mechanic.text: If the Merger closes, ownership, financing and the capital structure of
can change in ways the filed statements do not show.

credit_implication.text: are pre-closing and cannot be read as the post-closing credit profile.

findings.title: A launch after the quarter end is outside the reported period

evidence.text: The quarterly report discloses a launch of mobile sports betting and iGaming in Alberta, Canada on July 13, 2026

risk_mechanic.text: The launch is an operating event after the reporting period, so it does not enter the reported amounts for
and cannot be assumed in them.

credit_implication.text: Any effect of the launch on the results of
must come from later periods, not from this pack.

findings.title: Long-term financing obligations sit outside reported debt

evidence.text: The balance sheets show long-term financing obligations at June 30, 2026
as a separate line from long-term debt.

risk_mechanic.text: carries large fixed financing obligations on its leases that sit beside, not inside, its borrowed debt, so debt measures alone understate fixed claims.

credit_implication.text: must read these obligations with the debt note and cannot rely on debt totals alone.

findings.title: Adjusted EBITDA and net debt are issuer-defined non-GAAP measures

evidence.text: The earnings release presents Adjusted EBITDA and net debt as non-GAAP measures
defined by the issuer, and no covenant definition is in the pack.

risk_mechanic.text: defines Adjusted EBITDA by its own add-backs and lease treatment, which can differ from any credit agreement definition.

credit_implication.text: Leverage built on the issuer measure for
cannot be assumed to match covenant leverage.

rationale.text: No leverage metric is available because the calculation gate is blocked, so this dimension is not assessed.
No coverage metric is available because the calculation gate is blocked, so this dimension is not assessed.

Source quality and the timing of disclosed events are addressed.
The issuer definition of Adjusted EBITDA is addressed.
The pending Merger and the financing obligations are addressed.

Every located balance-sheet row was reviewed. Only long-term financing obligations are a named liability outside debt that is large enough to matter to funding; the other lines are standard operating balances.

limitations: The narrative covers data quality, definitions and gaps only, because no KPI is available.
